name: chassis-models-kinematics
title: Chassis SI models and kinematics
description: Implement software-only H1/H2 body-frame SI types, constraints, feasibility/saturation evidence, and mecanum-4, omni-3/4, and swerve-4 forward/inverse kinematics with deterministic host tests.
creator: mj
notes: Software-only H1/H2 complete: four classified application crates, canonical body Twist2 reuse, immutable saturation evidence, normalized fixed-size least squares, mecanum-4, symmetric/custom omni-3/4, and swerve-4 reversal/rate-limit/angle-hold behavior. Twenty-three targeted tests, zero-allocation assertions, architecture policy and full CI pass. Lifted-chassis, CAN-load and physical morphology qualification remain open hardware gates.
